sam: Heads up — staging hit an OOM last night during a long 64k-token convo. Root cause looks like KV slab fragmentation + delayed async reclaim (KV kept growing until allocator failed).

maya: Reproable? steps?

sam: Yep. Quick repro: run loadgen with longctx=65536, batch=8, concurrent streams 4. Script:```./loadgen --model rwd-7b --seq 65536 --batch 8 --concurrency 4 --profile kv``` Repro hits within ~2-6 minutes on a single GPU canary.

linh: Which kernel path? Any kernel-selection churn that could explain pinned allocations?

sam: Kernel selector flipped to the fallback quant path mid-run (cuda-amp-int8 -> fallback-int8-soft), that path uses slightly different KV layout which led to small allocs mapped to new slabs but the reclaimer wasn't coalescing because fragment estimate < trigger threshold. Also batch coalescing prefetched KV for many sequences so live set spiked.

maya: Do we have traces/pprof?

sam: Uploaded flamegraph + pprof snippet to the repro bucket. Key pprof snippet:```# pprof top 10
50.2%  runtime.allocSlab
22.1%  kv.reclaimWorker
10.5%  kernel_select
4.3%   batch_coalesce
2.9%   cudaMemcpyAsync
```Shows reclaim worker running but doing many tiny ops and not coalescing.

rafa: Proposed mitigation: async incremental slab shrinker that coalesces adjacent free slots and performs bounded evictions under predicted longctx growth. Add a feature flag: `KV_ASYNC_SHRINK=true` plus tunables `KV_SHRINK_THRESHOLD=0.6` and `KV_SHRINK_BATCH=8`.

sam: Draft patch posted in PR #5123. Key pseudocode:```if (estimated_fragmentation > KV_SHRINK_THRESHOLD) {
  schedule_async_shrink(KV_SHRINK_BATCH);
}
// shrink does: lock shard; try coalesce N slabs; evict low-score prefixes; unlock
```

linh: Concern: shrinker racing with allocator can cause eviction thrash if too aggressive. Suggest single shrink worker per device + exponential backoff on failures. Also, make reclaim idempotent and avoid taking hot locks during kernel launches.

maya: Also worth adding a soft degrade route: if kv_mem_gauge / total_gpu_mem > 0.75 and predicted seq_len > 32k, route to smaller model variant or enable conservative batching. That avoids immediate OOMs for customer traffic.

sam: Added these metrics to the patch: `kv_frag_ratio`, `kv_slab_count`, `kv_shrink_ops_total`, `kv_eviction_retries` and a derived alert `kv_frag_ratio > 0.7 for 2m -> page oncall`.

infra-bot: canary deploy queued: redwood/kv-shrink/v1 -> 5% targets (will auto-promote on success).

rafa: I'll run rollout. Plan: 5% 30m -> 25% 60m -> 100% 2h. Monitor OOMs, tail latency, and heap oscillation. Rollback if OOMs > 0 or OOM rate increases by >0.01% or p99 latency > 2x.

linh: I'll run microbench matrix: kernels [amp-int8, fallback-int8-soft, fp16], batches [4,8,16], seq [8k,32k,64k] and watch `kv_frag_ratio` and `kv_shrink_ops_total`. Will post results to the PR.

maya: I'll add dashboards: per-device kv_mem_gauge, kv_frag_ratio, shrinker latency, and a histogram for eviction retries. Also added a test in the perf harness that simulates long-convo growth.

sam: Thanks. Sam -> owner of repro and initial metrics. Rafa -> rollout. Linh -> bench and kernel stress. Maya -> dashboards/alerts.

maya: Created issue #987 with steps, repro, links to flamegraphs, and rollback playbook.

sam: Quick notes on followups: consider integrating kernel-selection heuristics with predicted seq_len so we avoid switching to the path that fragments under long context. Also evaluate prefix-KV prefetch policy: reduce prefetch window when seq growth predicted.

rafa: Noted. Will add kernel-selection guard to canary if bench signals it.

sam: Let's sync in 30m in #eng-runtime if anyone can join. Thanks :thumbsup:
